subject: Geological hotspot
hook: GEOLOGICAL HOTSPOT IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Scientists estimate there could be anywhere from about 20 to several thousand geological hotspots, yet most geologists think only a few dozen actually exist.
angle_support: Estimates for the number of hotspots postulated to be fed by mantle plumes have ranged from about 20 to several thousand
most geologists considering a few dozen to exist
title: How Many Hotspots Are There Really?
description: The number of geological hotspots on Earth is a subject of significant scientific debate, with estimates varying wildly. Most experts recognize a few dozen, but the upper end of projections suggests thousands.
narration: GEOLOGICAL HOTSPOT IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a few dozen fixed volcanic sources beneath the Earth. It was closer to a massive disagreement, with estimates ranging from twenty up to several thousand sites. While most geologists currently agree that only a few dozen hotspots exist, the scientific community remains divided. This uncertainty stems from complex mantle plumes that are notoriously difficult to model, image, or even consistently define. The ground beneath our feet hides far more than we know.
